prompt: Write 5 short claim log entries by an auto insurance adjuster for a rear-end collision claim. Injury: concussion. The claimant is represented by a lawyer. Start each entry on a new line with 'Entry 1:', 'Entry 2:' and so on. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1122; do not mention it.)
text:
Entry 1: Claim opened following a rear-end collision at a signalized intersection. Insured vehicle was stopped at the light when struck from behind by a third-party vehicle. Police report requested. Insured reports neck stiffness and headache, no airbag deployment. Vehicle is drivable but damage is being photographed and appraised.

Entry 2: Third-party driver's carrier acknowledged liability coverage and assigned a field appraiser. Claimant has retained counsel, who has requested that all communications be routed through the firm. Letter of representation received and logged. Future contact with claimant to be made only through counsel.

Entry 3: Medical records request sent to the treating urgent care facility. Claimant was diagnosed with a concussion and advised of post-injury restrictions, including limits on screen time and driving until cleared. Counsel has indicated a demand package will follow once treatment concludes. Neurology referral noted in the file.

Entry 4: Appraisal complete on the claimant's vehicle. Repair estimate received and reviewed. Rental coverage confirmed for the duration of repairs. Counsel's office requested a copy of the appraisal report, which has been sent. Follow-up scheduled to check on the status of the neurology consultation and symptom progression.

Entry 5: Received updated treatment notes indicating ongoing post-concussion symptoms, with a recommendation for continued monitoring and rest. Reserves reviewed and adjusted to reflect the bodily injury exposure. Claim remains open pending receipt of the demand package from counsel. Supervisor notified of the representation and the injury classification.
